templates.name: 基础数值查询
templates.description: 基础数值查询，不做任何聚合计算

templates.name: 环比趋势查询
templates.sql_template:
SELECT
    {date_column},
    {field} AS metric_value,
    LAG({field}, 1) OVER (ORDER BY {date_column}) AS prev_value,
    {field} - LAG({field}, 1) OVER (ORDER BY {date_column}) AS diff,
    ROUND(({field} - LAG({field}, 1) OVER (ORDER BY {date_column})) / NULLIF(LAG({field}, 1) OVER (ORDER BY {date_column}), 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_rate
FROM {table}
WHERE metric_code = '{metric_code}'
  AND {date_column} BETWEEN '{start_date}' AND '{end_date}'
ORDER BY {date_column} DESC
templates.description: 环比趋势查询，计算当前值与上期值的差和环比增长率

templates.name: 同比查询
templates.sql_template:
SELECT
    t1.{date_column} AS date,
    t1.{field} AS current_value,
    t2.{field} AS last_year_value,
    t1.{field} - t2.{field} AS diff_value,
    ROUND((t1.{field} - t2.{field}) / NULLIF(t2.{field}, 0) * 100, 2) AS yoy_rate
FROM {table} t1
LEFT JOIN {table} t2
    ON t1.{date_column} = DATE_SUB(t2.{date_column}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
    AND t1.metric_code = t2.metric_code
WHERE t1.metric_code = '{metric_code}'
  AND t1.{date_column} BETWEEN '{start_date}' AND '{end_date}'
ORDER BY t1.{date_column} DESC
templates.description: 同比对比查询，对比去年同期数据

templates.name: 排名查询
templates.sql_template:
SELECT
    {dimension},
    {field} AS metric_value,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY {field} DESC) AS rank_num,
    ROUND({field} / SUM({field}) OVER () * 100, 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM {table}
WHERE metric_code = '{metric_code}'
  AND {date_column} BETWEEN '{start_date}' AND '{end_date}'
GROUP BY {dimension}, {field}
ORDER BY rank_num
LIMIT {top_n}
templates.description: 排名查询，支持 GROUP BY 下钻维度

templates.name: 分组排名查询
templates.sql_template:
SELECT
    {dimension},
    {field} AS metric_value,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY {dimension} ORDER BY {field} DESC) AS rank_num,
    ROUND({field} / SUM({field}) OVER (PARTITION BY {dimension}) * 100, 2) AS pct_of_group
FROM {table}
WHERE metric_code = '{metric_code}'
  AND {date_column} BETWEEN '{start_date}' AND '{end_date}'
GROUP BY {dimension}, {field}
ORDER BY rank_num
LIMIT {top_n}
